indication_area: Hemophilia A or B with inhibitors, congenital factor VII deficiency, Glanzmann's thrombasthenia, acquired hemophilia (bleeding episodes and surgery)
moa: Recombinant activated coagulation factor VII (bypassing agent) that activates factor X on activated platelets to generate thrombin in patients with inhibitors

approval_evidence.quote: NOVOSEVEN RT (coagulation Factor VIIa, recombinant) lyophilized powder for solution, for intravenous use Initial U.S. Approval: 1999

series_start_reason: 2001Q1 is the first quarter any electronic EDGAR filing prints: the Q3 2002 report (6-K filed 2002-10-31, the earliest electronic Novo Nordisk filing; all earlier 6-Ks are .paper documents on the EDGAR index) carries a seven-quarter table running Q1 2001 to Q3 2002, so 2001Q1-2002Q2 are its comparative columns (direct_retrospective_table). No document located prints a quarter before Q1 2001: the Annual Report 2000 on novonordisk.com has no quarterly table, and the Annual Financial Report 2002 6-K prints quarterly figures for 2001 and 2002 only. NovoSeven itself launched in 1996, so the series starts at a sourcing boundary, not at launch.
series_end_reason: Novo Nordisk's Q1 2026 and Q2 2026 reports (caq12026.htm, caq22026.htm) print no NovoSeven row: the rare disease table carries only 'Rare blood disorders' and a footnote lists NovoSeven among its components; the Q4 2025 report (caq42025.htm) still prints a NovoSeven row of 1,803.
notes: Worldwide sales in DKK million. The product line is printed as NovoSeven (earlier reports: 'Haemostasis management', which the 2002 to 2003 reports name as NovoSeven); NovoSeven RT is the room-temperature-stable presentation sold under the same line, so the line is the brand total and the drug_name NovoSeven RT is the product the attributes describe. Accounting basis: 2004Q1-2004Q3 are Danish GAAP figures from the quarter's own report; the FY2004 report (first IFRS report) restates those quarters, so the 2004 quarters sum to 4,385 while the FY2004 report prints 4,359 (1,170 + 1,086 + 1,084 + 1,019). All other years' quarters sum to the full-year figure printed in the Q4 report (2003: 3,875; 2005: 5,064; 2006: 5,635; 2007: 5,865; 2008: 6,396; 2009: 7,072; 2010: 8,030; 2011: 8,347; 2012: 8,933; 2013: 9,256; 2014: 9,142; 2015: 10,064; 2016: 9,492; 2017: 9,206; 2018: 7,881; 2019: 8,119; 2020: 7,203; 2021: 7,221; 2022: 8,308; 2023: 7,958; 2024: 7,983; 2025: 7,326). 2002 is a partial year (Q3 and Q4 only). 2015Q2-Q4, 2016Q2-Q4 and 2008Q4 are derived from year-to-date figures (see rows). 2015Q1 onward the sales-by-therapy table nests NovoSeven under Haemophilia ('Hereof NovoSeven' in 2015); the 2015 line change was +18% in DKK against 2014Q1 2,247, consistent with the same scope. 2018Q1 and 2018Q2 cite PDFs on novonordisk.com because the EDGAR copies render tables as images. 2001Q1-2002Q2 are comparative columns of the Q3 2002 report and are labelled direct_retrospective_table; 2002Q3 onward are read from each quarter's own report.
search_log: listed Novo Nordisk (CIK 0000353278) 6-K, 20-F and 20-F/A filings via data.sec.gov submissions; filings before 2002-10 are .paper (no text); electronic reports from 2002-10 onward were opened

2002Q3-2003Q4: quarterly numbers table in each quarter's own 6-K (rows labelled Haemostasis management); a EUR table sits beside it and was not used; 2004Q1-2014Q4: NovoSeven row of the quarterly numbers table, current quarter first (2009Q4: FY2009 report table runs oldest to newest)

2015-2016: the reports print NovoSeven only as a year-to-date line in the sales-by-therapy table (Hereof NovoSeven / NovoSeven under Haemophilia); no quarterly numbers table row was found for NovoSeven in those reports, so 2015Q2-Q4 and 2016Q2-Q4 are year-to-date differences
2017Q1-2025Q4: NovoSeven row of the sales-by-geographical-area table, first (Total) column of the quarter

2008Q4: the quarterly table of the FY2008 6-K prints 1.774 (decimal point for thousands separator), so the quarter is derived as full year 6,396 less nine months 4,622; the 2009Q1 report prints 1,774 for the quarter

2026Q1 and 2026Q2: opened caq12026.htm and caq22026.htm; no NovoSeven row (rare blood disorders aggregate only), so the series ends at 2025Q4; a separate Novo Nordisk Excel sales supplement was not searched for
Full-year check: quarters summed per year against the full-year NovoSeven figure printed in the Q4 report; all agree except 2004 (IFRS restatement, see notes)
FDA: NovoSeven BL 103665 (fda.gov/vaccines-blood-biologics/approved-blood-products/novosevenrt); label 'Initial U.S. Approval: 1999' on DailyMed
launch quarter not established from an issuer document in this series (series starts 2002Q3 while the product predates it), so launch_quarter is null
